alt: The inference stack as layered slabs, top to bottom: serving engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang); continuous batching, drawn as request lanes where a finished request frees its slot for a new one; Flash Attention, drawn as a score matrix streamed tile by tile into on-chip memory; quantization, drawn as one weight at 16, 8, and 4 bits; the paged KV cache, drawn as three sequences mapped onto scattered memory blocks; and the GPU with its memory stacks. Numbered squares mark four of the layers, top to bottom: batching, the attention kernel, FP8 quantization and the paged KV cache.
caption: The serving stack, from engine to GPU. Batching and the paged KV cache come switched on in vLLM and SGLang, and precision is the layer left to choose.
